channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.0

The first public release of the new ThisWeek desktop app for Apple silicon Macs.

  • Capture microphone and system audio for meetings.
  • Create, organize, edit, and sync meeting notes.
  • Local transcription and summary workflows.
  • Menu-bar operation and launch-at-login support.
  • Secure native updates powered by Sparkle.
